title: First Missionary Journey Begins, Paul's Sermon at Pisidian Antioch

questions.question: Who were the prophets and teachers at the church at Antioch when the Holy Spirit called Barnabas and Saul?
options: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen, and Saul
Peter, James, John, Barnabas, and Saul
Silas, Timothy, Titus, Barnabas, and Paul
Philip, Agabus, Barnabas, Silas, and Saul
questions.correctAnswer: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen, and Saul
questions.explanation: Acts 13:1 (ESV): "Now there were in the church at Antioch prophets and teachers, Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen a lifelong friend of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul."

questions.question: What were they doing when the Holy Spirit commanded them to set apart Barnabas and Saul for the work?
options: Worshipping the Lord and fasting
Praying and studying the Scriptures
Celebrating the Lord's Supper together
Meeting with representatives from Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Acts 13:2 (ESV): "While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, 'Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.'"

questions.question: On Cyprus, they encountered a false prophet and sorcerer named Bar-Jesus (or Elymas). Who was he with?
options: Sergius Paulus, the proconsul, an intelligent man who wanted to hear the word of God
The governor of Paphos and his Jewish advisors
The high priest of the temple of Aphrodite on Cyprus
A Roman senator visiting the island on official business
questions.correctAnswer: Sergius Paulus, the proconsul, an intelligent man who wanted to hear the word of God
questions.explanation: Acts 13:7 (ESV): "He was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of intelligence, who summoned Barnabas and Saul and sought to hear the word of God."

questions.question: Paul (Saul) rebuked Elymas the sorcerer who was opposing their preaching. What punishment did Paul pronounce on him?
options: He would be blind and unable to see the sun for a time
He would be struck dumb and unable to speak
He would be paralyzed and carried about like a child
He would be filled with fear and flee the island
questions.correctAnswer: He would be blind and unable to see the sun for a time
questions.explanation: Acts 13:11 (ESV): "And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon you, and you will be blind and unable to see the sun for a time."

questions.question: When Sergius Paulus saw what happened to Elymas, what was his response?
options: He believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord
He was afraid and asked them to leave the island
He was delighted and offered them gifts and honor
He called for more sorcerers to dispute with Paul
questions.correctAnswer: He believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord
questions.explanation: Acts 13:12 (ESV): "Then the proconsul believed, when he saw what had occurred, for he was astonished at the teaching of the Lord."

questions.question: In his sermon at Pisidian Antioch, Paul traced history from Egypt to David. He quoted Psalm 2 about Christ: "You are my Son, today I have..."?
options: "begotten you."
"glorified you."
"sent you."
"anointed you."
questions.explanation: Acts 13:33 (ESV): "...which God fulfilled to us their children by raising Jesus, as also it is written in the second Psalm, 'You are my Son, today I have begotten you.'"

questions.question: Paul preached that through Jesus "forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you, and by him everyone who believes is freed from everything from which you could not be freed by..."?
options: the law of Moses
sacrificial offerings
ritual cleansing
circumcision
questions.explanation: Acts 13:38-39 (ESV): "...through this man forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you, and by him everyone who believes is freed from everything from which you could not be freed by the law of Moses."

questions.question: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of God. The Jews saw this and were filled with what?
options: Jealousy and contradicted what was spoken by Paul, reviling him
Fear at the power of Paul's preaching
Curiosity and asked Paul many questions after the service
Anger at the crowds for neglecting the synagogue practices
questions.correctAnswer: Jealousy and contradicted what was spoken by Paul, reviling him
questions.explanation: Acts 13:45 (ESV): "But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy and began to contradict what was spoken by Paul, reviling him."

questions.question: Paul and Barnabas declared: "It was necessary that the word of God be spoken first to you. Since you thrust it aside and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we are turning to..."?
options: the Gentiles
other cities of Israel
all who will hear us
the lost sheep of Israel
questions.explanation: Acts 13:46 (ESV): "...behold, we are turning to the Gentiles."

questions.question: Paul quoted Isaiah to justify turning to the Gentiles, saying God had made him "a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to..."?
options: "the ends of the earth."
"all who believe."
"every nation under heaven."
"the lost and the found."
questions.explanation: Acts 13:47 (ESV): "For so the Lord has commanded us, saying, 'I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.'"

questions.question: The Gentiles hearing Paul's message were glad and glorified the word of God. "And as many as were appointed to eternal life..."?
options: believed
responded
were saved
received the Spirit
questions.explanation: Acts 13:48 (ESV): "...and as many as were appointed to eternal life believed."

questions.question: Who was the young man who accompanied Paul and Barnabas from Jerusalem but left them at Pamphylia and returned to Jerusalem?
options: John Mark
Timothy
Silas
Titus
questions.explanation: Acts 13:13 (ESV): "Now Paul and his companions set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. And John left them and returned to Jerusalem,"

questions.question: Paul declared that David, after he had served the purpose of God in his own generation, did what?
options: Fell asleep and was laid with his fathers and saw corruption
Was taken up to heaven like Enoch before him
Rested in the tomb awaiting the resurrection of the just
Was preserved from corruption by God's special promise
questions.correctAnswer: Fell asleep and was laid with his fathers and saw corruption
questions.explanation: Acts 13:36 (ESV): "For David, after he had served the purpose of God in his own generation, fell asleep and was laid with his fathers and saw corruption,"

questions.question: The Jews stirred up the devout women of high standing and the leading men of the city and drove Paul and Barnabas out. What did Paul and Barnabas do in response?
options: Shook the dust from their feet against them and went to Iconium
Called a curse on the city before departing
Returned to Jerusalem to report to the apostles
Prayed for the city and departed peacefully
questions.correctAnswer: Shook the dust from their feet against them and went to Iconium
questions.explanation: Acts 13:51 (ESV): "But they shook off the dust from their feet against them and went to Iconium."

questions.question: Despite being driven out, the disciples in Pisidian Antioch remained in what state?
options: Filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit
Steadfast and unmoved in their faith
Eager to follow Paul and Barnabas wherever they went
Fearful but determined to continue meeting together
questions.correctAnswer: Filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Acts 13:52 (ESV): "And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit."

key_verse_text: "For so the Lord has commanded us, saying, 'I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.'"
